function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are the law.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways, 35 mph on residential streets.
• “No speed limit” zones exist in some rural areas. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• No “no‑seat‑belt” law for drivers. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless hands‑free).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Tx Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (0.02% BAC).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Tx Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | Tx Code §545.021 | | **School Bus** | • Must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Vehicles traveling in either direction must stop. | Tx Code §545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Overtaking on the right is prohibited unless the vehicle being overtaken is turning left. | Tx Code §545.021 | | **Parking** | • No parking on sidewalks, in front of driveways, or in fire lanes.
• Parking in a “no parking” zone is a ticket. | Tx Code §545.021 | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing of vehicles is regulated; towing companies must be licensed.
• Private towing is allowed but must follow specific rules. | Tx Code §545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV | | **Special Situations** | • **HOV lanes**: Only vehicles with 2+ occupants (or electric vehicles) may use.
• **High‑occupancy toll (HOT) lanes**: Pay tolls to use. | TxDOT | | **Penalties & Enforcement** | • Fines vary by offense; repeat offenders face higher penalties.
• Points are added to driver’s record; 4 points in 12 months can lead to license suspension. | TxDMV, Tx Code §545.021 | ### Quick Resources - **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – [https://www.txdmv.gov](https://www.txdmv.gov) - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) - **Texas Transportation Code** – [https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/](https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/) (search for §545.021 for driving laws) Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
